title: Senior Executive - Accounts Receivable & Project Accounting
description:
### **About Zeeco:**



Zeeco is a global leader in the design and manufacture of advanced combustion and environmental solutions for the refining, petrochemical, chemical, LNG, power, pharmaceutical, and allied industries. With engineering and manufacturing facilities across the globe, Zeeco delivers innovative combustion technologies and world\-class customer support to clients in more than 100 countries.


### **Position Summary:**



Zeeco India is seeking an experienced **Accounts Receivable professional** with **5–10 years of relevant experience** in a **manufacturing, EPC, oil \& gas, engineering, or project\-based organization**. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in **Accounts Receivable, Customer Collections, Project Billing, Credit Control, and Revenue Tracking**, with exposure to project accounting and **Percentage of Completion (POC)** accounting being highly desirable.



The incumbent will work closely with Finance, Project Management, Sales, and Customers to ensure timely invoicing, collections, accurate receivable accounting, and effective working capital management while supporting project financial reporting.



### **Key Responsibilities:**


### **Accounts Receivable Management:**


* Manage end\-to\-end Accounts Receivable activities for domestic and international customers.
* Generate and review customer invoices in accordance with contractual milestones, project schedules, and commercial terms.
* Monitor outstanding receivables and ensure timely recording and allocation of customer payments.
* Reconcile customer accounts and resolve billing discrepancies, short payments, debit notes, and credit notes.
* Maintain accurate customer ledgers and ensure receivable balances are reconciled on a regular basis.
* Review customer credit limits and coordinate with internal stakeholders on credit\-related matters.

### **Customer Collections \& Credit Control:**


* Drive collection of outstanding receivables through regular customer follow\-ups.
* Coordinate with Project Managers, Sales, Commercial, and Customers to resolve payment delays and invoice disputes.
* Monitor customer aging reports and prioritize collection of overdue accounts.
* Prepare weekly and monthly collection status reports, cash flow forecasts, and escalation summaries for management.
* Support initiatives to improve **Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)**, collection efficiency, and working capital performance.
* Maintain strong customer relationships while ensuring timely realization of payments.

### **Project Billing \& Project Accounting Support:**


* Coordinate project billing based on contractual milestones, shipment schedules, engineering progress, or project completion stages.
* Support project accounting activities by tracking project costs, billings, receivables, and customer advances.
* Assist in maintaining project\-wise financial records and supporting schedules.
* Work closely with Project Managers to validate billing milestones, project progress, and commercial documentation.
* Monitor unbilled revenue, customer advances, retention amounts, and milestone\-based receivables.

### **Revenue Recognition (POC Accounting):**


* Support revenue recognition under the **Percentage of Completion (POC)** method in accordance with applicable accounting standards and company policies.
* Assist in monthly project cost reviews and revenue calculations.
* Coordinate with Project Finance and Operations teams for project progress validation.
* Prepare supporting schedules for project profitability analysis and revenue reporting.

### **Financial Reporting \& Compliance:**


* Support month\-end and year\-end closing activities relating to Accounts Receivable and project accounting.
* Prepare customer reconciliations, AR schedules, aging analysis, and management reports.
* Ensure compliance with accounting standards, internal controls, and company policies.
* Assist during statutory audits, internal audits, tax audits, and financial reviews.
* Identify process improvement opportunities to enhance billing accuracy, collection efficiency, and reporting.
### **Qualifications:**


* **M.Com graduate** with **5–10 years of relevant experience** in Accounts Receivable.
* Experience in **Manufacturing, Oil \& Gas, EPC, Engineering, Industrial Equipment, Process Equipment, Heavy Engineering, or Project\-based organizations** is highly preferred.
* Working knowledge of project billing, milestone invoicing, customer collections, and receivable accounting.
* Exposure to **Percentage of Completion (POC) Accounting** and **Revenue Recognition** will be an added advantage.
* Experience working with ERP systems such as **Sage X3 or similar ERP platforms**.
### **Required Skills:**


* Strong knowledge of **Accounts Receivable, Customer Collections, Credit Control, and Customer Reconciliations**.
* Good understanding of project\-based billing and commercial documentation.
* Knowledge of revenue recognition and project accounting concepts.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including **Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, IF formulas, data analysis, and reporting**.
* Strong analytical, numerical, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with Finance, Sales, Project Management, Commercial, and Customers.
* High attention to detail with strong organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced multinational environment.
### **Preferred Experience:**


* Accounts Receivable Management
* Customer Collections \& Credit Control
* Project Billing
* Milestone\-Based Invoicing
* Project Accounting
* Percentage of Completion (POC) Accounting
* Revenue Recognition
* Customer Reconciliations
* Working Capital Management
* Financial Reporting
* Advanced Microsoft Excel
### **What You'll Gain:**


* Opportunity to work with one of the world's leading combustion and environmental solutions companies.
* Exposure to global project accounting and multinational finance operations.
* Hands\-on experience in project billing, customer collections, revenue recognition, and working capital management.
* Cross\-functional collaboration with Project Management, Commercial, Sales, and Global Finance teams.
* Career growth within a multinational engineering and manufacturing organization.
* Exposure to large\-scale industrial, oil \& gas, refinery, petrochemical, LNG, and power sector projects.

title: Sr IT Analyst - SAP Finance/ECC/S4HANA
description:
As a Sr IT Analyst here at Honeywell, you will lead complex, high\-impact IT projects, using your expertise to provide guidance on IT strategy and drive data\-informed decision\-making. Your responsibilities will involve analyzing intricate IT systems, identifying areas for improvement and innovation, and offering solutions to address business challenges. By staying current with emerging IT trends and technologies, you will directly contribute to the organization's technology roadmap. Your work as a Sr IT Analyst will not only enhance operational efficiency but also maintain our competitive edge and position as a global technology leader.


  
**Qualification**

* Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline or equivalent work experience Project management process, methods and tools application PMP and/or ITIL certification preferred . Abundant deployment experience in Agile and Waterfall methods
* 6\-10 years in\-depth experience of supporting SAP Finance modules with preferable expertise in SAP New GL, Assets Management, FSCM, Bank Management, etc. as well as integration with other modules
* The candidate should have end\-to\-end process knowledge in Finance domain, understand business process in SAP Automatic Bank Payment, Payment process, Month end closure process, etc.
* IT partnering skills with Business or peers during deployment, excellent ability of business requirement gathering, translation.
* Ability to mentor peers on project management standards and Finance GDM, deep experience in data migration for new implementation
* Deep understanding of key program management practices with strong finance business acumen and customer focus
* Consistently makes timely decisions even in the face of complexity
* Drive "fast and right" results in matrixed environment, excellent communication skills and ability to communicate at all levels in the organization
* Ability to create business value through project planning and management
* Deployment experience of ECC \& S4 HANA systems for Finance function

  
**Key Responsibilities**

1\) Responsible for SAP Finance deployment globally at Honeywell different Strategic Business Group. Set up FICO configuration under the global model and deliver system on time.


2\) Responsible for FICO system enhancement via rapid delivery process and take immediate action to support business in case of urgency, i.e. month\-end closure, critical financial period.


3\) working with Partners, IT BP /Business directly, as SAP Center of Excellence focal, to implement the approved SAP finance processes. Execute Project Build by involving Multi Vendors, such as Banks, stakeholders from different party. Defines project requirements and identification of appropriate technology for Finance Business during Idea phase.


4\) To develop functional specification in SAP Finance in order to enhance the existing solutions. By working with SAP Run team or Contractors to build new process, Reports, Automation or other activities wherever required to meet business needs. To develop test plans / test scripts and perform unit and Integration testing during project implementing.


5\) To identify and manage Risks proactively. Have the responsibility to take action on potential risks/issues and provide proposals to senior management if escalation is required.


6\) Candidate should have at least 1 deployment experience on S4 HANA Finance implementation. Knowledge of RAR \& FI\-CA is added advantage.


  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Financial Reporting and Planning COE Analyst, APAC
description:
FMC Corporation is a global leader in agricultural sciences, driven by our purpose: Innovation for Agriculture. Solutions for the Planet. We are passionate about the power of science to solve agriculture’s biggest challenges. With one of the most productive and diversified pipelines in the industry, FMC is delivering cutting\-edge and next\-generation crop protection technologies – including Dodhylex™ active, Isoflex™ active, rimisoxafen, and fluindapyr – to help farmers increase the productivity and resilience of their land. Our employees are at the heart of this innovation. We’re looking for bold thinkers and collaborative doers. At FMC, your ideas matter. From day one, you’ll contribute to meaningful work that drives progress in agriculture, supported by a culture that values integrity, safety, respect, and results. Join us in advancing the future of agriculture. Together, we’re building a more resilient planet – one innovation at a time.

**Job Summary**


You will play a key role in the preparation of management reporting, variance analysis and forecasting, delivery of annual budgets; as well as profitability analysis to support pricing and operational decisions to the APAC businesses. In addition to routine reporting for the APAC region and FMC’s Global Headquarters in the US, you also need to provide ad\-hoc financial analysis for APAC Leadership Team to support critical business decisions. You will also support commercial activities such as pricing analysis, market share analysis, and the like.


This role requires working in partnership with regional and global COE teams and leverage of COE resources to better achieve the below key responsibilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintains a robust business partnering relationship with key stakeholders \- Sub\-Region Finance Teams, Regional \& Global COE’s
* Prepare consolidated monthly and quarterly financial reporting packages, understand, and explain variances to budgets, forecasts \& prior years. Deep dive the root causes of variances and work proactively with the different sub\-regions to institutionalize improvements and remedy unfavorable performance.
* Budget \& quarter\-end corporate presentation preparation on dedicated data sections related to Working Capital, Cash Flow, Bridges \- Revenue, EBIT and SAR Spends
* Provide technical guidance to sub\-regional teams \& offer management reporting solutions when there is a business/operation change or when associated accounting change happens, which requires good understanding among management reporting, local books, and consolidation
* Assist with the annual budgeting process, including preparation of supporting templates, and consolidation of business submissions
* LRP (Long Range Planning) data preparation as required together with MR\&P COE Lead
* Work closely with MR\&P COE Lead to drive reporting and business improvement as required by leveraging SAP S4/HANA and associated planning and reporting platforms (including BPC, Fiori, and AFO)
* Drive process improvement efforts to reduce time, facilitate analysis \& better decision\-making
* Lead project initiatives that create value\-add for the finance function
* Support SOX and internal audit as needed
* Work with the relevant stakeholders to better understand the actual results along with the drivers, facilitate consolidation of forecasts, quarter\-over\-quarter analysis
* New Product Introduction Tracking \- Work with the Sub\-Region Finance teams to summarize the latest view of the new launches planned for the year
* Good understanding of FX and Hedging related topics
* Tracking of SG\&A spend \- Monitor actuals and facilitate meaningful budgets \& forecasts
* Develop a good understanding of key levers impacting Accounts Receivable \& DSO, monitoring \& tracking the same with relevant stakeholders on a regular basis

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in accountancy, Finance, Business Administration, or related discipline
* Minimum of 8 to 10 years of analytical and financial planning experience
* Strong communication (verbal and written) and interpersonal skills, attention to detail and ability to communicate complicated issues effectively
* Ability to work in a matrix organization
* Demonstrated ability to perform consistently under varying business pressure as well as ability to adapt to a quickly changing environment
* Ability to work across levels within the organization and foster strong relationships with others
* Solution oriented approach in problem solving
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (e.g., Excel \& Power point)
* SAP S4, BPC/AFO, Power BI/Tableau experience preferred
* Ability to multi\-task and work with minimal supervision (self\-motivated)
* Ability to handle large data sets
* Proficient in English

title: Finance Analyst
description:
### **Responsibilities**


**1\. Budgeting \& Financial Planning**

* Lead the review/analyses of annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and strategic financial plans for all hospitality assets.


* Coordinate with asset managers, hotel operators, and finance teams to gather inputs and validate assumptions.


* Analyze variances between actual performance and budget/forecast, providing actionable insights.


**2\. Cash Flow Management**

* Prepare periodic cash flow statements to ensure liquidity planning and working capital efficiency.


* Monitor receivables, payables, project cash flows, operator remittances, and capital expenditure requirements.


* Identify cash flow risks and propose mitigation strategies.


**3\. Financial Reporting \& Analysis**

* Analyze monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements for hospitality assets, including P\&L, balance sheets, and cash flows.


* Track expenses, operational KPIs, and performance trends across hotels.


* Provide financial insights and recommendations to enhance asset profitability and returns.


**4\. Support for Asset Performance Optimization**


* Collaborate with business development and asset management teams to evaluate financial implications of deals, contracts, and refurbishment projects.


* Support deal structuring with financial models, scenario analyses, and ROI assessments.


* Review operator reports and validate financial submissions for accuracy and compliance.


**5\. Audit \& Compliance**

* Support internal and external audit processes with timely documentation, reconciliations, and financial clarifications.


* Ensure adherence to accounting standards, internal controls, and company financial policies.


* Assist in reviewing and strengthening financial governance frameworks for hospitality assets.


**6\. Documentation \& Stakeholder Coordinati**on


* Prepare management reports, dashboards, and financial summaries for senior leadership.


* Coordinate data inputs from hotel operators, commercial, legal, and business development teams to ensure financial integrity.


* Maintain organized financial documentation, reports, and audit\-ready records.
